title: Saatvik Green Energy shares surge 10% after Rs 1,041 crore SECI order
summary: Saatvik Green Energy shares surged 10% after the company secured a Rs 1,041.63 crore solar PV module supply order from SECI, with execution scheduled by December 2027. The order comes amid growing demand for solar modules and renewable energy capacity.
